info.description: A Marena villa (1, 2, or 4 bedroom). One entry per physical villa. The architect said the existing Divi villa pages were 'not special' — the schema is intentionally restrictive so a non-technical editor cannot break the editorial layout.

tagline.description: One-line hero subtitle. Hard cap 120 chars so it never wraps ugly on mobile.

longDescription.description: Editorial copy. Use sparingly. Plain prose, no marketing fluff.

features.description: Array of {label, icon}. Keep under 8 items — the layout assumes 6-8 features max.

heroImage.description: Hero image. Recommended 2400×1500 (8:5) landscape. Anything else will be letterboxed.

gallery.description: Curated gallery, 6–10 images only. Architect's directive: edit down, don't dump the full Divi photo set.

order.description: Display order on /villas (lowest first). Use to put the 4BR flagship first.
